design: Additional disjoint fixed-page descriptive verification; not a statistically independent benchmark
selection_rule: Use each stated body-page label in each volume, record the first matching sequence position, retain any inaccessible or uninformative page without outcome-based replacement. None is one of the ten original pages.
anchor_rule: Select up to two visibly readable scientific-name strings per page before executing prototype searches; record visual inspection as assistant/tool assisted, no human ground truth. Prefer full binomials when present, otherwise preserve abbreviations exactly. Retain text-layer discrepancies.
exclusions: No restricted platform content, no human participants, no classification of accepted names or synonyms, no OCR/LLM/vector service during replay.
conditions: Use the unchanged anonymous source snapshot, PyMuPDF 1.28.2, new disposable database for each run. Record failures and offsets; do not change extraction logic.
planned_controls: Repeat the replay in a new store
Absent strings verified absent in the full selected text
Stored labels versus search result fields
claim_scope: String handling and page locator behavior within the selected pages only; no precision/recall or user/taxonomic benefit.
